newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSI Services says must verify Hang Seng indices.
newsitem.headline: HSI Services says must verify Hang Seng indices.

text.p: Hang Seng Index Services Ltd said Thursday's Hang Seng Index, Hang Seng Midcap 50 Index and Hang Seng China Enterprises Index would require further verification.

The company, which calculates the Hong Kong stock market's Hang Seng indices, said it would release the official opening, high, low and closing values for the three main indices as soon as the verification process was completed.
The verification was needed due to technical malfunction in the stock exchange's Automatic Order Matching & Execution System, it said in a statement.
The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong earlier said that due to a technical malfunction, the previous closing prices of stocks and indices shown on its computer information system were wrong.
The correct closing levels were shown in free text areas at the bottom of the Exchange's Teletext system screens, it said.
